forumventures-forum-ventures:ashbyhq:915.description: Forum's Venture Studio https://www.forumvc.com/studio brings together ambitious people, brilliant ideas, and capital to build the best B2B SaaS businesses in the world, from 0 to 1. In addition to capital and an idea, we provide founders with access to investor networks, fundraising support, and the resources needed to build transformational companies. Our AI Studio has launched 17 companies since 2023, and we're launching 7 more in 2026. We're designed to help Founders move faster, develop better insights, and build companies that have a higher success rate than startups built in any other way. What We're Looking At: The cloud giants spent two decades convincing enterprises to move everything off-prem. AI is reversing that for a significant share of compute. Data sovereignty, latency requirements, regulatory constraints, and the math that owning GPUs beats renting after 18 months are pushing workloads back on-premises and to the edge. Enterprises want the cloud experience on hardware they control, not a return to 1990s IT. Forum AI Studio is looking for a Founder exploring any of these themes: - Managed on-prem AI platforms with a cloud-like operating experience on enterprise-owned hardware - Distributed edge inference as a service across customer sites and devices - Intelligent inference routing across cloud, neocloud, and owned GPU fleets - and more! Maybe you've deployed inference across hybrid cloud and owned silicon and felt the gap between what engineering teams need and what enterprises will actually run in production. Maybe you've sold into VP Platform or infrastructure buyers who own hardware decisions. That's who we build with. Forum derisks and accelerates the Founder path by: - A $250K USD investment, and an end-to-end fundraising playbook and network to raise your seed and Series A - A validation partner with proven playbooks, networks, and the systems to validate, unlock your ICP, ignite your sales pipeline, and beyond - The support of our experienced operating team - from business design, product development, growth, recruitment, legal and more - Executing a winning GTM strategy to get to $50-100K ARR, and the right MVP to ensure early traction - A community full of mentors, peers, and leaders - $100K+ worth of business perks About you: - Early-stage operator experience with a proven track record of building, selling, and navigating the AI infrastructure and compute platform world. - You may have run ML platform or infrastructure teams deploying inference across cloud, neocloud, and owned GPU or edge hardware. - You may have sold into VP Platform, data center, or infrastructure buyers and know what makes hybrid deployment conversations survivable at renewal. - The ability to attract, hire and lead world-class teams - A demonstrated passion for technology's ability to change the world - A desire to be a venture-backed founder - Canada or US-based, and the ability to collaborate in North American time zones. Please note, this is not an employment opportunity with Forum Ventures. If you are currently fundraising your pre-seed or Seed round, please pitch our investment team instead here https://www.forumvc.com/pitch-us.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:68bef0dd-1a05-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UI/UX Designer based in Bulgaria. This is a senior design role focused on creating intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across web and mobile products. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Establish and maintain strong visual design systems, applying disciplined grids, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Use AI-powered design and creative tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, and rapid prototyping while maintaining a high standard of design quality. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Present design concepts and decisions clearly to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while confidently explaining design rationale. Take ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery, identifying problems and developing thoughtful, creative solutions. Help structure and organise design work, documentation, and workflows so projects progress efficiently across distributed teams. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively within a fully remote environment. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e657d63d-b737-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Resource Contact Center Analyst - Senior based in the United States. This senior-level role is central to delivering advanced technical support and exceptional customer experiences across complex IT infrastructure environments. You will troubleshoot sophisticated hardware and software issues spanning compute, virtualization, networking, and storage technologies.
